players.name: Joe Burrow
players.summary: Threw for 292 yards and four second-half touchdowns as Cincinnati erased a 13–0 halftime deficit to beat Baltimore 35–13 on October 25.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.summary: Caught nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in Seattle's 20–3 Sunday-night win over previously unbeaten Kansas City.

players.name: Bo Nix
players.summary: Passed for 222 yards and a touchdown and rushed for 75 yards, including a 62-yard score, in Denver's 30–16 win at Arizona.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.summary: Threw for 208 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for another score as Miami beat the Jets 28–25 for its first win of 2026.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.summary: Rushed for 124 yards and a touchdown, including a 42-yard overtime run setting up the Giants' 27–21 win over Houston.
